name: tyomarkkinatori
description: Työmarkkinatori (tyomarkkinatori.fi), the Finnish public employment services portal. This CLI searches open job postings and reads their details, searches public trainings and services and reads course and service details, lists occupation info pages, and reads the code lists the site's filters use (municipalities, regions, working time, languages and so on).

commands.name: search-jobs
commands.summary: Full-text search of open job postings, with optional municipality and publish-date filters, sorting and paging

params.name: query
params.description: Search keyword(s), e.g. an occupation or employer name

params.name: municipality
params.description: Municipality code (KUNTA code list, e.g. 837 = Tampere, 091 = Helsinki). Use list-codes --codeset KUNTA to look codes up.

params.name: publishedAfter
params.description: Only postings published after this ISO timestamp. The UI's 'within 1 month' option sends now minus 1 month.

params.name: sort
params.description: Sort order: LATEST = newest first, CLOSING = nearest application deadline first

params.name: page
params.description: Zero-based page number

params.name: pageSize
params.description: Results per page

commands.name: get-job-posting
commands.summary: Get the full public details of one job posting by its UUID: description, employer, location, contacts, application info

params.name: id
params.description: Job posting UUID (the id field from search-jobs)

commands.name: list-codes
commands.summary: List the codes in a KOPA code list, e.g. municipalities, regions, working time, employment relationship or languages. Use these codes to interpret job posting fields and job search filters.

params.name: codeset
params.description: Code list name

params.name: validOn
params.description: Return codes valid on this date (YYYY-MM-DD), normally today

commands.source: E9 E10 E11 E12 E13 E14 E15 E16 E17 E18 E19 E20 E21 E22 E23 E24 E26 E27 GET https://tyomarkkinatori.fi/api/codes/v1/kopa/MAAKUNTA/koodit

commands.name: list-isco-occupations
commands.summary: Get the ISCO occupation group hierarchy (notation codes with fi/sv/en labels and nested narrower groups). Job search uses these as occupation groups.

commands.name: search-trainings
commands.summary: Search public trainings and services (courses, labour market training) by keyword, with offset paging

params.name: query
params.description: Search term, e.g. an occupation or subject

params.name: pageSize
params.description: Results per page

params.name: offset
params.description: Number of results to skip

commands.name: get-training
commands.summary: Get one training or course implementation by token: dates, location, description, language requirements, registration link and provider

params.name: token
params.description: Service implementation token (UUID; the token from search-trainings or the /kurssi/{token}/ URL)

commands.name: get-service
commands.summary: Get the general description of a service or training product (description, requirements, target groups, category, its offerings) by service token

params.name: token
params.description: Service token (UUID; serviceOffering.service.token from get-training or search-trainings)

commands.name: list-service-categories
commands.summary: List the service and training categories (codes like PK1, PK7.3 with names) used in the trainings and services catalogue

params.name: language
params.description: Label language

commands.name: list-service-codes
commands.summary: List a code set used by the trainings and services catalogue, e.g. target groups, language skill levels or education codes

params.name: codeset
params.description: Code set name

params.name: language
params.description: Label language

commands.source: E4 E5 E6 E7 E8 E29 GET https://tyomarkkinatori.fi/api/employmentservicecatalogue/v1/CodeSets/ESCO_AMMATTI

commands.name: list-professions
commands.summary: List all occupations that have an occupation info page (label and slug path), for use with get-profession

params.name: locale
params.description: Language

commands.name: list-profession-fields
commands.summary: List occupational fields (ammattialat) with their info page paths

params.name: locale
params.description: Language

commands.name: get-profession
commands.summary: Read an occupation info page (job description, education, outlook) by slug

params.name: slug
params.description: Occupation slug, the last segment of path in list-professions (e.g. sairaanhoitaja)

notes: search-jobs: leave out the optional filters (municipality, publishedAfter) when they are not needed. The web app omits a filter key entirely when it is unused.
search-jobs paging is zero-based. Pages are counted from 0, the response's lastPage is the highest page index, and totalElements is the hit count.

Other job search filters were seen in the UI but their request body keys were not captured: occupation group (ISCO code, e.g. 3), working time (TYÖAIKA code, e.g. 01 = full-time) and application deadline. Use list-codes or list-isco-occupations to interpret the codes in results.
Job posting fields such as workTime, employmentRelationship, continuityOfWork and municipality values are KOPA codes. Resolve them with list-codes (TYÖAIKA, PALVELUSSUHDE, TYÖN_JATKUVUUS, KUNTA).

Training data comes in three levels. A training or course (get-training) belongs to a serviceOffering, which belongs to a service. Use get-service with serviceOffering.service.token to read the general service description.
Most text fields are multilingual objects keyed fi/sv/en, or arrays of {language, value}.
Favorites, saved searches and profile features require a Suomi.fi login and are not available.
